# GDV Calculator | Residual Land Value Workbench

> Free gross development value calculator and residual land value workbench. BCIS build cost by region (from named council viability studies), NPPF Aug 2026 viability, sensitivity heatmap, no signup

Medians run £1,345/sqm (Tees Valley) to £1,882/sqm (Wandsworth). Calculator included

- [Development Finance Interest Roll-Up](https://gdvcalculator.co.uk/cost-lines/finance-and-interest-roll-up): Development finance interest roll-up. S-curve drawdown, arrangement, monitoring, exit fees. IRR vs flat-rate quote

- [SDLT on Development Land](https://gdvcalculator.co.uk/cost-lines/sdlt-on-development-sites): SDLT on development land. When non-residential rates apply, when 5 percent surcharge applies. MDR abolished June 2024; six-or-more-dwellings rule remains
- [Section 106, CIL and BNG Calculator](https://gdvcalculator.co.uk/cost-lines/section-106-cil-bng): Section 106 obligations, Community Infrastructure Levy and 10 percent Biodiversity Net Gain. When each applies, and how to model per unit

- [Bridging Loan Against GDV](https://gdvcalculator.co.uk/finance/bridging-loan-on-gdv): Bridging loan against GDV. Lenders publish refurbishment bridges at 70 to 75 percent of GDV and monthly rates from 0.62 percent (Precise, Nov 2026). Bridge-to-development re-finance
- [Development Exit Finance Calculator](https://gdvcalculator.co.uk/finance/development-exit-finance): Development exit finance. Published rates 0.65 to 0.87 percent a month (Allica, Precise, LendInvest, Nov 2026), up to 75 percent LTV. Decision aid vs continuing on the dev facility

- [Senior vs Mezzanine Development Finance](https://gdvcalculator.co.uk/finance/senior-vs-mezzanine): Senior vs mezzanine development finance. Published senior caps 65 to 70 percent LTGDV, stretch senior to 75 percent (Hodge Bank), senior pricing from 5.00 percent plus Bank Rate (West One). Inter-creditor terms. Pref-equity alternative

- [Scheme Types Office To Resi Conversion](https://gdvcalculator.co.uk/scheme-types/office-to-resi-conversion): Class MA prior approval or full planning conversion. Loads a new-build BCIS figure as a starting point; replace with a QS figure
- [Scheme Types Permitted Development C3](https://gdvcalculator.co.uk/scheme-types/permitted-development-c3): Class MA or G prior-approval conversion. NDSS now applies; daylight or BRE often kills schemes pre-residual
- [Scheme Types Self Build](https://gdvcalculator.co.uk/scheme-types/self-build): Single dwelling self-build with HMRC VAT reclaim on materials. Target return lower than commercial development
